response.sql: WITH kept AS (SELECT r.name AS raceName, ds.points AS pts FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0), per_race AS (SELECT raceName, AVG(pts) AS avgPts FROM kept GROUP BY raceName), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avgPts) AS overallAvg FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceName AS name, p.avgPts AS average, p.avgPts - o.overallAvg AS difference FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avgPts IS NOT NULL AND o.overallAvg IS NOT NULL AND p.avgPts > o.overallAvg;
